lore.text: Rank 1. Everything is new: the keys feel stiff, the words feel long, and every clean word lands like a small victory. Every typist who reaches rank 1 remembers the run that got them here — not because it was perfect, but because it was the one where they stopped guessing and started trusting their hands.
